name: Array
summary: Converts text into an ordered array of items using delimiter, newline, or regex splitting. Outputs the full array and individual items.

inputs.description: Input text to split into array items

outputs.description: Full array as JSON string representation
Individual array item selected by selectedOutputIndex

executionNotes: Splits input text based on splitMode: 'delimiter' (uses custom delimiter), 'newline' (splits by \n), or 'regex' (uses regexPattern). Can trim whitespace from items and optionally remove empty entries. The selectedOutputIndex parameter allows selecting a specific array item for downstream connections.

exampleConnections.scenario: Pass array of prompts as a structured list to a prompt builder
Use selected array item as prompt for image generation
